home.heroTitle: An elegant envelope that opens on your guest’s phone
home.heroSubtitle: Design your wedding or event invitation in minutes: a wax-sealed envelope that opens, music, a countdown, the evening’s agenda and one-tap RSVP — then share it with a single WhatsApp link.
home.heroPoint1: No app — it opens in the browser
home.heroPoint2: A private link for every guest, by name
home.stepsTitle: Three steps and your invitation is ready
home.step1Title: Pick a design and its colour
home.step1Body: Classic, romantic and modern designs — each in several ready colours to match your celebration.
home.step2Body: Names, both Hijri and Gregorian dates, the venue on the map and the evening’s agenda — in one clear form.
home.step3Body: Send each guest their own link over WhatsApp, and watch who accepted and who declined as it happens.
home.guestTitle: Not an image you send — a moment they live
home.guestSubtitle: A paper invitation is opened once and forgotten. Yours stays on your guest’s phone: it reminds them, shows them the way, and collects their reply.
home.f1Body: The moment your guest opens the link, a wax-sealed envelope opens in front of them — a first impression no image gives.
home.f2Body: A calm track suited to your occasion starts as the envelope opens, with a clear mute button always in reach.
home.f3Body: How long is left, in front of your guest every time they open it — with one-tap “add to calendar”.
home.f4Body: The hall’s name with a button that opens the map directly — no copying, no “where exactly is it?”.
home.f5Body: Attending or not, and how many are coming with them — it reaches your dashboard instantly.
home.f6Body: Reception, dinner, the ceremony — the whole evening inside the invitation, so nothing is missed.
home.templatesTitle: A design for every occasion, a colour for every design
home.pricingTitle: Pay for the invitations you send — nothing more
home.pricingSubtitle: No monthly subscription and no complicated bundles: a flat price per invitation, starting at 25.
home.pricingLink: Work out your cost by guest count
home.ctaTitle: Let your invitation be the first thing that impresses them
home.ctaBody: Choose your design, fill in your event details, and share it with your guests the same day.
home.ctaWhatsappMessage: Hi, I have a question about Dawati
home.footerTagline: Refined digital invitations for your occasions — designed in minutes, lived moment by moment.

admin.deleteThemeUnused: No event uses this theme. Deleting is permanent and cannot be undone.
admin.deleteThemeInUse: This theme is used by {count} events. Pick a replacement design to move them to before deleting.
admin.deleteThemeNoReplacement: There is no other published theme to move these events to. Publish one first, or archive this theme instead of deleting it.
admin.deleteThemeUnlinks: It also unlinks the theme from {count} client or pinned event.
admin.deleteThemeSeededNote: Heads up: this theme ships with the seed, and npm run db:seed recreates it under the same slug — run the seed after deleting and it comes back.
admin.deleteThemeArchiveHint: Instead of deleting, you can archive it: it leaves the gallery and keeps working in every existing invitation.
admin.deleteThemeErrorRequired: Pick a replacement theme for the events using this one.
admin.deleteThemeErrorReplacement: That replacement is not valid — it must be a published theme other than the one being deleted.
admin.deleteThemeErrorMissing: Theme not found — it may already have been deleted elsewhere.
admin.themeAdvancedNote: Fields controlling how the theme appears in the gallery and which animated effects the invitation runs.
admin.themeFamilyHint: Slug of the base design these colorways belong to, so they group into one gallery card. Leave empty for a standalone design.
admin.themeColorTagHint: The color's Arabic name, e.g. كحلي — shown in the gallery's color filter.
admin.themeSwatchHint: The swatch uses the accent color by default. Turn this on when the accent no longer matches the design's real color.
admin.themeArtworkNote: The images and their positions on the card are not edited here. Convert the design to the visual builder using the convert button at the top of this page and edit them there.
admin.builderThemesNote: Designs built in the theme builder: artwork, layers and multiple colorways.
admin.legacyThemesNote: Themes from the previous system, edited in the old editor.
admin.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes only, e.g. rose-gold
admin.builderNextStepNote: The editor opens right after creating — images, layers and the remaining colorways are added there.
admin.builtinFontsNote: These ship with the site itself, so they load faster than added Google fonts.
admin.googleFontsNote: Fetched from Google when the invitation opens, which costs one extra request.
admin.fontFamilyHint: Type the name exactly as it appears on Google Fonts
admin.confirmDeleteFont: Remove this font from the library?
admin.convertToBuilderHint: Moves this theme's artwork and text positions into layers you can drag in the visual editor. The old settings are kept as they are.
admin.convertMergeColors: Merge this design's colors ({count}) into one theme
admin.convertConfirm: This theme moves to the visual editor. Existing invitations keep working, and you can switch it back at any time. Continue?
admin.convertConfirmMerge: This theme moves to the visual editor and {count} colors are merged into one design. The other color rows are archived, never deleted — invitations pointing at them keep working. You can undo all of it later. Continue?
admin.convertedBadge: This theme runs on the visual editor
admin.revertToLegacyHint: Deletes the editor layers and redraws the theme from its saved settings, restoring the merged colors as separate published themes.
admin.revertConfirm: The theme goes back to the old system and its editor layers and colors are deleted. Merged colors come back as separate published themes. Continue?
admin.revertRestoreColors: Restore the merged colors ({count}) as published themes
admin.deleteThemeInUseOne: This design is used by 1 event. Choose a replacement design to move it to before deleting.
admin.deleteThemeInUseTwo: This design is used by 2 events. Choose a replacement design to move them to before deleting.
admin.deleteThemeInUseFew: This design is used by {count} events. Choose a replacement design to move them to before deleting.
admin.deleteThemeInUseMany: This design is used by {count} events. Choose a replacement design to move them to before deleting.
admin.eventEditNote: These are the customer’s own details — anything you change here shows up immediately in the invitations and entry passes already sent.
admin.pricingIntro: The price of one invitation. Editing here affects new orders only — paid orders keep the price they were sold at.
admin.legacyPlansNote: No longer sold, kept so older orders can still name what they bought.
